description: Passes one randomly chosen channel of a polyphonic input, choosing again on each trigger

inputs.text: A rising edge chooses a new channel at random, which happens only while the poly input and the output are both patched
The polyphonic signal one channel of which reaches the output, 16 channels at most

outputs.text: The voltage of the chosen channel, on its own

notes: a channel is picked afresh only while trig, poly and out are all patched; with any of the three unpatched the output keeps the channel picked last.
